answer.says: The bookseller, you. It is Diwali, yet the shop is open. Do your shelves not require rest? Or does the system of needs not recognize the festival?
answer.thought: The haze thickens the light, turning the sun into a pale coin behind a veil. The bookseller stands among his shelves, an island of order in the civil society of the market. I find myself curious to know if his stock has changed, or if the holiday has merely paused the flow of customers rather than the logic of commerce.
